newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Indesen denies change of parent, business.
newsitem.headline: Indesen denies change of parent, business.

text.p: Indesen Industries Co Ltd on Friday denied market rumours of a change of the company's controlling shareholders and a change in its principal business of manufacture and sale of video cassettes.
"The board would like to state that such reports and rumours are incorrect," the company said in a statement.

"There has been no significant change in the company's business performance as compared to past years," it said. "The board does not expect any significant change in the group's operating performance in the foreseeable future."
Indesen said its audited consolidated net asset value per share was about HK$0.18 as at March 31, 1997.
The company's shares, which have risen HK$0.11 or 18.64 percent in the last four trading days, gained a further HK$0.10 or 14.29 percent to HK$0.80 in late Friday morning.
